review.shorterRoute: The existing Gamma0 proof compares actual Hecke principal divisors via the literal norm, then uses torsion-freeness of the target integer divisor group to cancel a principal multiple. Reuse this route on original Gamma1 fields. The new Gauss norm works on all valuation integers, so native primitive constant normalization replaces the stronger coefficientwise-integral Laurent fraction decomposition. No good-reduction model of the upper Hecke correspondence is needed for this comparison.
assumptionsToDischarge: The actual original Gamma1 Hecke divisor correspondence equals the divisor of the literal alpha norm of beta.
The actual residue norm gives coefficient-Frobenius diamond plus p times inverse coefficient Frobenius on integral principal divisors.
Primitive constant normalization and torsion-free integer-divisor cancellation extend the equality to every finite Picard torsion class without an upper-correspondence good-reduction model.
The same equivariant specialization and invertible-torsion injection transport the identity to original Picard torsion and actual Tate sequences: H*F = F*F*D + p, with Picard diamond label p.
review.remaining: Actual original Gamma1 coordinate-degree equality and genus preservation remain. The derived twisted coefficient relation does not close the previously conditional differently normalized relation. Its inverse-action coefficient normalization, global Galois realization, parabolic and coefficient/character realization, all-weight two-dimensional association, automorphy and literal higher continuation remain. 16/20; DUB-17--20 OPEN.
